description: Defines the interface 'phy_tap' for tapping into uplink symbols received by the PHY layer, allowing external processing and modification of resource grid symbols, and exposing received uplink resource grid data.

classes.name: phy_tap
classes.description: Interface for external access and modification of uplink symbols in the PHY layer.

methods.name: handle_ul_symbol
methods.description: Handles each received uplink symbol, providing access to the resource grid and scheduled PDUs for potential modification.

methods.name: handle_quiet_grid
methods.description: Provides access to the complete received uplink resource grid without any associated request.
